description: This file declares the interface for son_actions class which manages various station and radio control actions within the son namespace for the prplMesh controller. It includes function declarations for handling connections, steering, disconnections, sending messages, and handling dead radios/stations.

classes.name: son::son_actions
classes.description: A class providing static methods to manage station and radio actions in the SON layer.

methods.name: handle_completed_connection
methods.description: Handles a completed connection event for a client, updating database and sending necessary messages.

methods.name: add_station_to_default_location
methods.description: Adds a station identified by MAC address to a default location in the database.

methods.name: unblock_sta
methods.description: Unblocks a station identified by MAC address.

methods.name: steer_sta
methods.description: Performs station steering, including disassociation timers and restrictions.

methods.name: disconnect_client
methods.description: Disconnects a client from a BSS with specific disconnect reasons and source.

methods.name: set_radio_active
methods.description: Sets a radio interface's active state.

methods.name: send_cli_debug_message
methods.description: Sends a debug message to CLI clients.

methods.name: has_matching_operating_class
methods.description: Checks if radio capabilities match a given BSS operating class.

methods.name: send_cmdu_to_agent
methods.description: Sends a message to an agent.

methods.name: send_ap_config_renew_msg
methods.description: Sends a message to renew AP configuration.

methods.name: start_btm_request_task
methods.description: Starts a BSS Transition Management request task.

methods.name: send_client_association_control
methods.description: Sends a client association control message.

methods.name: handle_agent_ap_mld_configuration_tlv
methods.description: Handles the MLD configuration TLV from an agent.
